summary.result: Results also indicate that SPI3 and the EDI indices have a better capability of detecting drought events in Bangladesh compared to other SPIs; however, SPI1 produced erroneous estimates.
summary.background: A good number of drought indices have been introduced and applied in different regions for monitoring drought conditions, but some of those are region-specific and have limitations for use under other climatic conditions because of the inherently complex characteristics of drought phenomenon.
summary.method: Although newly developed, studies have demonstrated The Effective Drought Index (EDI) to perform better compared to SPIs in some areas.
